text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - asia-east2 GPU attach failures and autoscaler stall. Queue growing for hosted inference, requests seeing latency > 10s and some 5xxs. Paging oncall-nyc.

oncall-nyc: I'm on it. Seeing large pending pod queue in gpu-pool-asia-east2, autoscaler log shows repeated attach denies.

alice.sre: Can someone paste the autoscaler error lines?

ben.platform: Pasting recent autoscaler log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T02:43:12Z autoscaler: attach failed: "QuotaExceeded: The resource 'projects/redwood-prod/regions/asia-east2/...' exceeded quota"
2026-03-17T02:43:15Z autoscaler: attach failed: "AttachLimitExceeded: attach request rejected due to region attach limit"
2026-03-17T02:43:21Z node-claim: pod gpu-req-xyz pending -> backoff
```

carla-eng: Confirmed: GCP API is returning quota/attach limit errors, not internal attach timeouts. Looks like project-level attach rate cap + regional GPU quota is saturated.

oncall-nyc: Immediate mitigations: 1) Turn off noncritical lower-priority routes to reduce new requests. 2) Route traffic for high-volume customers to fallback region asia-southeast1 if healthy. 3) Reduce concurrency per-worker for in-flight inference to free up slots.

emily-product: We need a short customer note for impacted customers (low-latency SLA hits). David, can support draft a quick banner?

david-support: Drafting now: "We're investigating increased latency and failed inference requests in AP East (asia-east2). Engineers are actively mitigating by routing traffic and scaling in alternate regions. We'll post updates every 30 minutes." OK to post?

oncall-nyc: Yes post now and add link to status page.

ben.platform: Trying a manual workaround: spinning up a temporary gpu-pool in asia-southeast1 and enabling failover routing. Command I ran:
```bash
redwoodctl pools create --region=asia-southeast1 --type=dedicated-gpu --size=8 --tags=emergency-failover
redwoodctl routing update --from-region=asia-east2 --to-region=asia-southeast1 --policy=failover --weight=0.5
```
Result: pool created but some attach calls still hitting asia-east2 due to sticky sessions; rolling config to drop stickiness.

carla-eng: Also lowering per-request tokenization window and enabling short-circuit cache for common prefixes to cut token generation by ~30% for affected models.

alice.sre: I've opened a GCP support case and escalation with billing + quota team (case 1234567890). gcp-bot: any automated feedback?

gcp-bot: Case 1234567890 created. Suggested immediate action: request quota increase for GPUs in asia-east2 and request temporary attach rate lift. Recommended contact: rep-asia@gcp.example (internal). ETA for initial response ~ 45-90 minutes.

ben.platform: While we wait for GCP, pausing batch jobs that flood warm pools helps. I've applied node taints to prevent new low-priority provisioning to the region:
```bash
kubectl taint nodes -l region=asia-east2 key=emergency:NoSchedule --overwrite
```
This forced existing low-priority pods to evict and freed attach slots for critical inference workloads. Observed pending queue drop from 420 -> 160 in 6 minutes.

oncall-nyc: Good. What's current customer impact?

david-support: From monitoring: 12% of requests in AP East are returning 503s, median latency up to 9.4s, p95 ~ 28s for affected routes. A small subset of enterprise customers are on degraded fallbacks (smaller model) automatically. No data plane breaches.

emily-product: Escalate to account managers for top 5 impacted customers. Provide recommended mitigation steps they can apply client-side (lower concurrency, use retry backoff).

carla-eng: Another mitigation: enable quantized variant q8 on fallback models for AP East to reduce GPU memory and allow packing + more instances. Rolling that for low-priority routes.

alice.sre: Observability note: add a temporary alert on AttachLimitExceeded rate > 5/min so we can triage faster next time. I'll push the alert.

ben.platform: GCP responded: initial reply says region quota at soft limit due to partner reservations in that region. They asked for exact project and timeframe. I've shared our traffic graphs and asked for a temporary attach rate increase.

gcp-bot: GCP update: support engineer has started investigation, flagged internal quota pool pressure. No guaranteed lift yet, but prioritizing.

oncall-nyc: Summary of actions taken:
- Failover pool created in asia-southeast1 and routing adjusted (partial).
- Noncritical routes throttled, batch jobs paused, node taints applied in asia-east2.
- Quantized/fallback models enabled for degraded QoS.
- Support message posted and account managers notified.
- GCP case opened and escalated.

alice.sre: Next steps: continue monitoring. If GCP can't lift quota within 2 hours, we should shift heavier workload to other regions permanently for affected customers and schedule follow-up postmortem.

emily-product: Coordinating customer comms cadence: immediate banner posted, follow-up every 30 minutes, deep postmortem within 24 hours.

david-support: Posted update to customers: "Mitigation in progress; partial routing to fallback region and temporary reduced throughput. Next update in 30 minutes."

ben.platform: Current metrics: pending queue 160 -> 90 after failover routing and taints, 503 rate down to 6%. Latency median 3.2s. Trending improving.

oncall-nyc: I'll keep the bridge open. If anyone needs to take over, ping me. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident recorded (P1). Channel will be archived after handoff.
